prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and displaced, with the tail lamp assembly broken on the driver's side and the trunk lid edge bent inward. Crush depth and the pattern of damage on the quarter panel are mostly in line with the impact described by the parties. Repair labor hours fit the extent of the damage, and no earlier damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the prior file. The estimate includes one charge for a service that appears twice on the same invoice; the shop has acknowledged the second entry was a repeat and it should be removed. Recommended plan: replace the bumper cover, tail lamp, and trunk lid edge, then refinish and blend the adjacent panels.
